take-1.text: HQ, Starseeker. Booking accepted. Spinning up for the pickup.

take-2.text: HQ, Starseeker. We have the booking. Heading out now.

depart-1.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Flight plan filed. Departing now.

depart-2.text: Starseeker is clear of the pad. On our way.

pickup.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Passengers aboard, hatch sealed. Departing for the destination.

arrive-1.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Docked and secure. Passengers disembarking.

arrive-2.text: Starseeker is down safe. Thanks for the help, HQ.

hold.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Holding in orbit until the pad clears.

divert.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Diverting to the alternate pad. Passengers informed.

replan.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Replanning the leg. New plan to follow.

wait.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Waiting out the launch hold on the pad.

cp-launch-hold.text: Pan-pan, pan-pan. Dispatch, Starseeker. Launch hold on our pad. Standing by for your call.

cp-pad-closed.text: Pan-pan, pan-pan. Dispatch, Starseeker. Destination pad is closed. Requesting instructions.

dust-storm.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Dust storm over the pad. Passengers are secure. Riding it out.

titan-haze.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Thick haze over the pad. Passengers are secure. Holding until it lifts.

flare.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Solar storm warning. Passengers to the shelter. Holding on the ground.

correction.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Small course correction. Burning now, all normal.

late.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Running behind the plan. Passengers informed.

pad-full.text: Dispatch, Starseeker. Every berth is taken. Holding for a slot.

hq-link.text: Starseeker, HQ. Link confirmed. You are cleared to take bookings.

hq-out.text: HQ copies. Good flying. HQ out.

refused.text: Starseeker, HQ. Unable. Check the request and try again.
